//: Dev-server watch config. Without it nodemon watches the whole directory
for js/mjs/cjs/json, which restarts the API every time a test script is
edited — noisy, and it drops any in-flight request for no reason.
.env is watched deliberately. dotenv reads it once at startup, so pasting
a Plaid secret or changing a rate limit did nothing until the process was
restarted by hand, which is easy to forget and looks like the change not
working. Note that changing .env restarts the server but does NOT rerun
